note: Steps-to-leaps step 17: the same job (hear the landing note, then leap) in four settings, each staff with its own drone: the 4th and the 5th from the low Do on "oo", the same leaps on a second staff a few notes lower on "ah", calls and answers in minor, then a made-up tune in Mixolydian. The key is moves, so no heading or step names a key any more, and the {{?key}} line says each leap keeps its size.

exercise.title: 4ths and 5ths in three scales
exercise.why: A leap lands in tune when you hear the landing note before you sing it, so every block is the same job in a new scale: hear it, then leap.

cells.heading: Light first, then a new Do

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Leap from the low {{1}} up to {{4}} and back, then from {{1}} up to {{5}} and back. Sing it on "oo", which keeps your voice light.
Hear the landing note in your head before each leap, then check where your line lands.

Press Play on the second staff below to start its drone. Then press Start microphone.
Its {{1}} is a new note: sing the same leaps from the low {{1}}, now on "ah".
Practice until each leap lands without a slide from both Dos.

Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. The same leaps now sit in a minor scale, with {{b3}} added. Make up a short call that leaps up from {{1}}, and sing it on "oo". Then answer it with a different leap that ends on {{1}}, and sing the answer on "ee".
If the answer lands off {{1}}, sing {{1}} once on its own, then answer again.

Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Make up a short tune from {{1}}, {{4}}, {{5}} and {{b7}}, leaping between them in any order. Move through "ee-oh-oo-oh-ah" as you go.
When a leap misses, sing just that leap again slowly, then put it back in the tune.
{{?key}}In another key every drone moves with it, and each leap is still the same size.
